Direct-match candidates are abundant for type 2 diabetes mellitus. However, most candidates report only full-model AUROC/C-index with heterogeneous (often clinically heavy) covariate sets, making cross-model comparison of PRS signal difficult. Using the heritability sanity check: EUR local/liability h2 estimates for T2D in the retrieved records are on the order of ~0.09–0.17 (liability scale; with some UKB-LDSC entries much lower/unstable), so PRS-only R2 values in the low single digits are plausible and not obviously exceeding the heritability ceiling.

Limitation: several other direct-match models show higher full-model AUROC (e.g., PGS001781, PGS002308, PGS000804/805), but their PRS-only contribution is not visible here, so it remains unresolved whether they outperform PGS000014 as standalone PRS; hence confidence is moderate and the overall outcome is sub-optimal rather than high-quality.
